thread:
emma: incident-bot paged: PagerDuty alert fired: inference-proxy (service) — 5xx rate spike in us-west-2, threshold breach 5m > 2%.
incident-bot: Alert details: service=inference-proxy region=us-west-2 metric=5xx_rate value=2.8% threshold=2% link: https://pd/alerts/1769876543
alex: acked. I'm on it, checking dashboards.
sam: any customer impact? can we mute if it's noisy?
emma: looking at traces — spike mainly from a synthetic canary; real user error rate ~0.3%. No user-facing errors reported in SLO pages.
alex: logs show a flurry of 502s from router->model-backend connection resets. tossing a quick tcpdump.
emma: tried restarting the canary job about 30s ago, no obvious change yet.
alex: rolling back new router config on a single pod to test.
pd-bot: PagerDuty: alice@redwood acknowledged the incident.
sam: if it's canary, we can suppress until we confirm; but let's watch for escalation.
alex: rolled config back on pod-7, 5xxs dropped to baseline within 45s. keeping watch.
emma: good catch. scaling events show a burst of ephemeral pods causing transient routing table thrash.
alex: I'm going to hand this to night oncall in 20m. will post a short incident note.
incident-bot: Alert auto-resolved: PagerDuty alert 1769876543 auto-resolved after metric returned below threshold.
alex: confirmed auto-resolve. No customer impact. Flagging for follow-up: investigate router health checks + canary scheduling jitter. linking runbook: https://confluence/redwood/runbooks/router-thrash
sam: add postmortem task: adjust canary schedule jitter and add a short cooldown to router updates.
emma: noted. thanks all :thumbsup: /

alex: handing off to @jordan for overnight watch. jordan, FYI — keep an eye on us-west-2 router CPU & canary job restarts.
jordan: ack, I'll take over and ping if anything reappears.
